sections.Profile:
Ski Jump, released by Zaccaria of Bologna in 1978, is a single-player solid-state pinball machine on a ski-jumping theme, and one of only three Zaccaria games built around the National Semiconductor 8060 processor, alongside Strike and Space City.

- Manufacturer: Zaccaria
- Years made: 1978
- In production: no
- Type: Solid State
- Display: Alphanumeric
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Sports, Skiing, 1970s, Solid State, Winter, Single level playfield
